# Lore

## Task Pipeline

**Importance-based memory decay**: Daily job scores memories 0-10
using half-life decay model (`strength = 0.5^(age / half_life_days)`).
Retrieval count and confidence tier factor into scoring. Evicts
lowest-scoring when agent exceeds 500 memories. Transitions
unretrieved facts to `stale` confidence after 30 days. Also cleans
up invalidated facts older than 30 days beyond 2000 cap.

**Automatic consolidation**: Daily job groups recent facts (7-day
lookback) by repo and calls Haiku to extract higher-level patterns.
Stored as `consolidated/{repo}/{timestamp}` memories.

**Privacy filtering**: All memory writes (episodes, memories) pass
through `sanitizeContent()` / `redactSecrets()` to strip API keys,
JWTs, private keys, connection strings, and bearer tokens before
…

# ADR-014: Intelligent memory lifecycle

## Decision

### 2. Post-task auto-curation

After every task (PR, no-changes, failure, feature-request, onboard),
write an episode via `episode-writer.ts`. High-signal events get
Haiku lesson extraction → stored as `auto-curation/{ref}` memories.

### 3. Session diversification in search

Cap results to max 3 per source (agent_id + source combo) in RRF
merge. Prevents one verbose session from dominating search results.

### 4. Privacy filtering

`sanitizeContent()` strips API keys, JWTs, private keys, connection
strings, and bearer tokens before all memory writes (episodes,
memories, both MCP tool and REST API paths).

### 5. Importance-based memory decay

Daily job (5 AM) scores memories 0-10 based on:

- Recency: -1 per 30 days of age
- Content: …

## Context

Agent episodes and memories provide essential context for Utopia queries.

## What to change

Intercept memory DB writes and mirror to Utopia memories and episodes sources.

Target file: `apps/lore-api/src/work/utopia/memory/utopia-memory.ts`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Memories correctly pushed to graph
- [ ] Walk endpoint for memories works

## How to test

Test interceptors for memory creation.

## References

- [specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md#Memories and episodes](https://github.com/re-cinq/lore/blob/HEAD/specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md#memories-and-episodes)

# Implementation Plan: Lore Platform

## Implementation Phases

### Phase 2: Feedback Loop + Memory System — COMPLETE

#### Memory System

- `memories`, `memory_versions`, `facts`, `fact_conflicts`, `episodes`,
  `entities`, `edges`, `snapshots`, `shared_pools`, `audit_log`.
- MCP tools: `lore_write_memory`, `lore_read_memory`, `lore_delete_memory`,
  `lore_list_memories`, `lore_search_memory`, `lore_write_episode`, `lore_query_graph`,
  `lore_assemble_context`, `lore_agent_stats`.
- Facts have temporal validity (`valid_from`/`valid_to`), confidence tiers
  (`verified`/`observed`/`inferred`/`stale`), and retrieval metadata.
- Contradiction detection: cosine similarity >= 0.92 triggers automatic
  invalidation + conflict record in `memory.fact_conflicts`.

## Why

- **`memory.facts.confidence`** (ADR-016 hippo-memory) was **missing**, so every
  `searchMemories()` threw `column f.confidence does not exist`. Both the
  `memories` and `episodes` context-assembly sources swallowed it — **memory +
  episodes were silently absent from ALL assembled context, org-wide**, hidden by
  the old `catch { return '' }`. (Prod has 717 facts / 786 episodes / 273 memories
  that never reached an agent.)
- **`pipeline.audit_log`** (dark factory) and **`memory.fact_conflicts`** did not
  exist — breaking auto-merge decision logging and conflict surfacing.
- **`ttl-cleanup`** hardcoded a non-existent `deleted` column (should be
  `is_deleted`), so the memory eviction job **failed every run**.
